run_fastcsp_full_workflow: run the FastCSP crystal structure prediction workflow with a YAML config file
run_fastcsp_specific_stages: run the FastCSP workflow with specific stages like generate and relax
run_fastcsp_with_config: run the FastCSP CLI with a config file to predict crystal structures
review_cli_main: review the FastCSP cli_main function and its argparse argument setup
refactor_cli_main: refactor the FastCSP cli_main to add new workflow stages or arguments
